title: Topic 6
japanese_text:
A：<u>デビュー</u>を目指して<u>こつこつ</u>応募してきたけど、この作品がだめだったら<u>潔く</u>諦めるよ。
B：本当に？ もう漫画家に<u>未練</u>はないの？
A：うーん。
english_translation: A: I've been working steadily on my application toward my debut, but if this piece doesn't work out, I'll bow out graciously. B: Really? With no regrets about becoming a manga artist? A: Well ...
